verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a per-sync debugger for checking runs and debugging rejected rows, run status reporting, and configurable alerts on failed runs, and a community source explicitly notes Hightouch has a 'live debugger, alerting' as a differentiator vs Census. However, this is centered on sync/reverse-ETL delivery rather than live event-stream observability, and there's no evidence of a unified cross-destination dashboard, real-time event flow visualization, or granular delivery metrics beyond pass/fail row-level debugging. missing for 10: live event-stream visualization/dashboard, detailed per-destination delivery metrics (latency, throughput, error rates), independent hands-on validation of the debugger/alerting UX.
